cat > /workspace/tmp/tests6.py << 'PYEOF'
import sys, json, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/tmp")
from harness import *

# ---- wire growth: hop1 raw exactly at limit accepts, hop2 grown wire -> syntax ----
ident = "sip:" + "n" * 240 + "@" + "m" * 12 + ".test"   # 256 chars
assert len(ident) == 256, len(ident)
b = batch([{}],  # placeholder, jobs set below
          directory={ident: ["tel:+1"]},
          accounts={"sk": {"primary": ident, "allow": []}},
          gateways={"edge": {"local_domains": ["m.test"], "peers": {}}})
base = req(frm="<tel:+1>;tag=q7", body="")
# reconstruct with big body instead: easier to pad body
body = "b" * 32000
lines = ["MESSAGE sip:inbox@relay.test SIP/2.0",
         "From: <tel:+1>;tag=q7",
         "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
         "Call-ID: sample-73",
         "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE",
         "Content-Type: text/plain",
         "Content-Length: %d" % len(body)]
base = "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n\r\n" + body
k = 32768 - len(base) - 9
pad = "X-Pad: " + "p" * k
ls = base.split("\r\n")
raw = "\r\n".join(ls[:5] + [pad] + ls[5:])
assert len(raw) == 32768, len(raw)
b["jobs"] = [
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "sk"}, "trusted_out": True, "raw": raw},
    {"gateway": "edge", "ingress": {"kind": "local", "subject": "sk"}, "trusted_out": True, "source": 0},
]
res = run(b)
check("grown wire hop1 ok", res[0]["status"], "accept")
check("grown wire hop2 syntax", res[1], rej("syntax"))

# ---- folded values / odd spacing ----
def one(raw, **kw):
    return run(batch([job(raw=raw, **kw)]))[0]
def wl(raw, i):
    return one(raw)["wire"].split("\r\n")[i]

check("folded from value", wl(req().replace("From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7",
    "From:\r\n <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7"), 1), "From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7")
check("ws-only continuation", wl(req().replace("To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
    "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>\r\n\t"), 2), "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>")
check("folded callid invalid", run(batch([job(raw=req().replace("Call-ID: sample-73",
    "Call-ID: sample-\r\n 73"))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("name case mix", wl(req().replace("Content-Type:", "cOnTeNt-TyPe:"), 7), "Content-Type: text/plain")
check("compact c", wl(req().replace("Content-Type:", "c:"), 7), "Content-Type: text/plain")
check("ws before colon", wl(req().replace("To:", "To \t:"), 2), "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>")
check("value outer trim", wl(req().replace("Call-ID: sample-73", "Call-ID: \t sample-73 \t"), 3), "Call-ID: sample-73")
check("ctype keeps inner ws", wl(req(ctype="  text/plain ; x=y  ".strip()), 7), "Content-Type: text/plain ; x=y")

# ---- params on PPI/RPID/PAI ----
check("ppi tag param", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:desk@sales.test>;tag=x",)))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("rpid tag param", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("Remote-Party-ID: <sip:desk@sales.test>;tag=x",)))])), [rej("syntax")])
check("pai tag param", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=x",)))])), [rej("syntax")])

# ---- account primary implicit allow ----
check("primary implicit allow", run(batch([job(raw=req(frm="sip:ember@studio.test;tag=t")],
    accounts={"session-k": {"primary": "sip:ember@studio.test", "allow": []}}))[0]["identity"], "sip:ember@studio.test")

# ---- unknown headers with junk values fine ----
check("junk unknown header", one(req(extra=("X-J: ()<>@,;:\\\"[]?={}",)) )["status"], "accept")

# ---- many headers ok ----
many = tuple("X-H%d: v" % i for i in range(200))
check("200 unknown headers", one(req(extra=many))["status"], "accept")

# ---- strict input handling ----
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],
                   input=b'{"directory":{},"accounts":{},"gateways":{},"jobs":[]}', capture_output=True)
check("minimal batch ok", (p.returncode, json.loads(p.stdout)), (0, {"results": []}))
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],
                   input=b'', capture_output=True)
check("empty input fails", p.returncode != 0, True)
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],
                   input=b'{"directory":{},"directory":{},"accounts":{},"gateways":{},"jobs":[]}', capture_output=True)
check("dup key input fails", p.returncode != 0, True)
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],
                   input=b'{"directory":{},"accounts":{},"gateways":{},"jobs":[], "x":NaN}', capture_output=True)
check("NaN input fails", p.returncode != 0, True)
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],
                   input=b'not json', capture_output=True)
check("garbage input fails", p.returncode != 0, True)
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-B", "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],
                   input='{"directory":{},"accounts":{},"gateways":{},"jobs":[]}'.encode(), capture_output=True)
check("trailing newline ok", p.returncode, 0)

# ---- scale: 2048 jobs ----
import time
big = batch([job(raw=req()) for _ in range(2048)])
t0 = time.time()
res = run(big)
check("2048 jobs", (len(res), all(r["status"] == "accept" for r in res)), (2048, True))
check("2048 jobs time<10s", time.time() - t0 < 10, True)

summary()
